edges.reason: lock modifier reads unlocked and reverts unless it equals 1 before the swap body runs
swap body writes unlocked=0 then restores unlocked=1, guarding against reentrant calls
swap invokes ISoarSwapV2Callee(to).SoarSwapV2Call on an untrusted contract with caller-supplied data
the caller-controlled 'to' parameter determines which contract receives the flash-swap callback
swap performs optimistic token transfers through _safeTransfer
_safeTransfer encodes the transfer(address,uint256) selector and executes the low-level token.call
the token parameter is the call target of the low-level transfer
the value parameter is the transfer amount encoded into the call
swap refreshes reserves and price accumulators via _update after the callback
_update writes reserve0 = uint112(balance0)
_update writes reserve1 = uint112(balance1)
_update stores the latest uint32 timestamp in blockTimestampLast
price accumulators depend on block.timestamp, making values miner-influenced
_update assigns local blockTimestamp from block.timestamp
local blockTimestamp is derived from the untrusted block.timestamp input
timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast relies on intentional uint32 overflow
price0CumulativeLast uses an unchecked accumulating addition
price1CumulativeLast uses an unchecked accumulating addition
swap passes msg.sender to the callback and the Swap event
amount0Out parameter drives the token0 outflow and reserve checks
amount1Out parameter drives the token1 outflow and reserve checks
to parameter receives output tokens and is checked against both token addresses
data length decides whether the flash-swap callback is executed
mint calls _mintFee before computing the new liquidity
mint issues LP tokens via _mint
_mint performs totalSupply = totalSupply.add(value) through SafeMath
mint reads totalSupply to compute pro-rata liquidity
mint calls _update to refresh reserves after minting
burn sends both underlying tokens out via _safeTransfer
burn destroys LP tokens
burn calls _update after re-reading balances
skim transfers the excess token balances via _safeTransfer
sync calls _update with the current token balances
permit requires deadline >= block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency
permit derives the signer using ecrecover over the typed digest
permit consumes and increments nonces[owner] to prevent replay
deadline parameter is the expiry compared with block.timestamp
owner parameter must match the recovered signer
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance unless it is uint(-1)
transferFrom updates LP balances through _transfer
createPair deploys the pair bytecode with the create2 opcode
createPair writes both directions of the getPair mapping
createPair appends the new pair to allPairs
tokenA parameter participates in ordering and duplicate checks
tokenB parameter participates in ordering and duplicate checks
setFeeTo requires msg.sender == feeToSetter
setFeeTo writes the privileged feeTo state variable
feeTo parameter is the new fee recipient value
setFeeToSetter requires msg.sender == feeToSetter
setFeeToSetter writes the privileged feeToSetter state variable
feeToSetter parameter is the new privileged address
initialize requires msg.sender == factory to prevent front-running
initialize assigns token0
initialize assigns token1
_mintFee queries ISoarSwapV2Factory(factory).feeTo() to decide whether fees are on
_mintFee reads kLast and can reset it to zero
_mintFee reads totalSupply when computing protocol fee liquidity
swap reads token0 for transfer and validation checks
swap reads token1 for transfer and validation checks
mint reads token0 balance of the pair
mint reads token1 balance of the pair
_totalSupply local caches totalSupply before _mintFee can modify it
feeOn local receives the _mintFee return value and controls kLast updates
liquidity is computed with sqrt, mul and division guarded by SafeMath
burn computes pro-rata amounts using liquidity.mul(balance)/_totalSupply
burn reads totalSupply as denominator and decreases it via _burn
balance0 parameter is bounded and assigned to reserve0
balance1 parameter is bounded and assigned to reserve1

normalization_plan.reason: amount0Out is a swap parameter consumed by the swap function's outflow logic
amount1Out is a swap parameter consumed by the swap function's outflow logic
to is the swap output recipient and callback target
data is the swap callback payload controlled by the caller
deadline is the permit expiry parameter checked against block.timestamp
owner is the permit signer parameter validated against the recovered address
tokenA is an input token parameter of createPair
tokenB is an input token parameter of createPair
feeTo parameter is written into the feeTo state variable by setFeeTo
feeToSetter parameter is written into the feeToSetter state variable
token parameter is the target address of the low-level transfer call
value parameter is the amount encoded into the low-level transfer call
balance0 is a temporary argument of _update before being cast to reserve0
balance1 is a temporary argument of _update before being cast to reserve1
blockTimestamp is a local derivation of block.timestamp used inside _update
timeElapsed is a local arithmetic value computed and consumed inside _update
_totalSupply is a mint-local snapshot of totalSupply used for liquidity math
feeOn is a mint-local flag returned by _mintFee and used later in mint
liquidity is a mint/burn-local computed amount that flows into _mint and _burn
